dreamteamer.title: Recordings
dreamteamer.description: One captured audio file and its transcript per `meeting-recordings` record — pulled out of `${env:INBOX_FOLDERS}` by content hash, filed under `${env:FILES_FOLDER}`, matched to its meeting, transcribed offline (faster-whisper + diarisation, Hebrew and English). Stamps `meetings.recordings` onto the meetings module's collection when installed. Depends on `meetings` and on nothing else: the transcript-gated steps that READ a transcript (summarise · extract tasks · analyse) are the `meeting-docs` module, which depends on this one.
